name: Horn-Renaming Defect
definition: For a nonempty binary class $C\subseteq\{0,1\}^E$, let $\mathcal M(C)$ be its complete family of minimal missing partial patterns. For a coordinate reflection $v\in\{0,1\}^E$ and $p\in\mathcal M(C)$, put $t_v(p)=|\{i\in\operatorname{dom}(p):p_i\neq v_i\}|$. Then $H(C)=\min_v\sum_{p\in\mathcal M(C)}\binom{t_v(p)}2$.
normalization: Repeated canonical 2-CNF clauses are counted with multiplicity. The empty missing-pattern family has value zero, including the zero-coordinate cube.
comments: The zero test is classical renamable Horn recognition. Positive values depend on the complete minimal-missing-pattern presentation and measure its minimum number of violated pair clauses.
